# StrixShort by StrixDevs

> StrixShort is an enterprise-grade URL shortener, QR code generator, and link analytics engine engineered by StrixDevs.

## Overview
- **Product Name:** StrixShort
- **Developer:** StrixDevs (https://strixdevs.com)
- **Primary Function:** High-speed URL shortening, branded slugs, vector QR code generation, campaign UTM building, and privacy-first click analytics.
- **Redirection Architecture:** Sub-50ms HTTP 302 redirection engine, with optional AdSense-monetized Safe Transit preview pages.

## Core Utilities
- **URL Shortener:** Convert long web links into compact Base62 slugs with custom alias options.
- **QR Code Studio:** Generate customizable, high-resolution PNG & SVG vector QR codes.
- **UTM Builder:** Construct Google Analytics campaign tracking parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content).
- **Link Inspector:** Safe link expansion and anti-phishing preview utility to inspect suspicious redirects without execution risk.
- **Real-Time Analytics:** Track click count, geographical distribution, device types (Mobile/Desktop/Tablet), top browsers, and referral traffic.

## API Documentation
- `POST /api/shorten`: Shorten a URL.
  - JSON Body:
    - `url` (string, required): Destination target URL.
    - `custom_slug` (string, optional): Custom 3-32 character alias.
    - `transit_mode` (string, default "direct"): "direct" (instant 302) or "safe_transit" (ad-monetized safe preview).
    - `password` (string, optional): Protect link with passcode.
    - `expires_at` (string, optional): Expiration timestamp.
- `GET /api/qr`: Generate instant QR code image with custom colors.
- `GET /api/inspect?url=...`: Inspect destination metadata, SSL status, and final resolved URL.
- `GET /api/analytics/{short_code}`: Retrieve JSON metrics for a short code.

## Publisher & Monetization
StrixShort supports family-friendly, Google AdSense-compliant intermediate safe transit pages. Publishers earn revenue while providing end-users with cybersecurity verification.
